title: Zero In Clothes Moths Killer Spray- Fast-Acting Insecticide with Prallethrin & 1R Trans Phenothrin - Kills Moths on Contact - For Wardrobes, Textiles & Clothes - Long-Lasting Moth Spray, 300ml Aerosol
bullet_points: INSTANT MOTH KILLER - The Zero In Clothes Moth Killer offers a quick solution for safeguarding your clothes and fabrics. This moth killer spray kills clothes moths on contact, delivering rapid knockdown and providing up to 12 weeks of protection

COMPREHENSIVE PROTECTION - The moth repellent for rooms is perfect for direct application to clothes moths and whole-room treatment. Spray in wardrobes, drawers and storage areas to create a protective barrier that deters and eliminates clothes moths

EFFECTIVE AGAINST MULTIPLE PESTS - This powerful moth killer for wardrobe protects against fabric-damaging pests like clothes moths and carpet beetles. With Prallethrin & 1R Trans Phenothrin, it ensures thorough pest control

PLEASANT SCENT - Zero In Clothes Moth Killer features a natural floral scent, making it a preferable choice for those sensitive to strong chemical odours. This provides effective moth control while keeping your spaces smelling fresh and clean

CARING FOR PEOPLE & THE PLANET – Zero In protects your health and home against Home Pest problems with minimal environmental impact. Zero In products are ethical and welfare-friendly solutions to everyday Home Pest problems that safeguard your well-being
